source.method: Instances of each of the 12 variants (three-key form Mod+Shift+K: ⇧ ⌘ K on Mac, Ctrl + Shift + K on Other, as the browser measured) in temporary frames with explicit Brand, Appearance and Density modes; bound variables resolved with resolveForConsumer; geometry read from the laid-out instance; the first key and the first separator measured.
